subject: Locate verified Codex native binary for Mac A2A EGM worker
body: Read-only locate the locally installed Codex CLI and model plugin executable on the resident Mac. No changes, no installation, no model invocation.

argv:
set +e
printf 'HOME=%s\n' "$HOME"
printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$PATH"
printf 'NODE='; command -v node
printf 'NPM='; command -v npm
printf 'CODEX='; command -v codex
printf 'NPM_GLOBAL_ROOT='; npm root -g 2>/dev/null
printf '\n--- known bins ---\n'
for f in /opt/homebrew/bin/codex /usr/local/bin/codex "$HOME/.local/bin/codex" "$HOME/.npm-global/bin/codex" "$HOME/.bun/bin/codex" "$HOME/.volta/bin/codex" "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin/codex "$HOME"/.fnm/node-versions/*/installation/bin/codex; do if [ -e "$f" ] || [ -L "$f" ]; then ls -l "$f"; fi; done
printf '\n--- Codex apps ---\n'
ls -ld /Applications/*Codex* "$HOME"/Applications/*Codex* 2>/dev/null
printf '\n--- indexed executables ---\n'
/usr/bin/mdfind -name codex 2>/dev/null | grep -E '(/bin/|Codex.app|node_modules|\.app/Contents|/codex$)' | head -35
printf '\n--- scoped filesystem paths ---\n'
for dir in "$HOME/.nvm" "$HOME/.codex" "$HOME/.local" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Codex" "$HOME/Documents/Codex" "$HOME/Applications" "/Applications"; do
if [ -d "$dir" ]; then /usr/bin/find "$dir" \( -name 'codex' -o -name 'codex-cli' -o -name 'codex-aarch64-apple-darwin' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -20; fi
done
printf 'A2A_NATIVE_CLI_DIAG_DONE\n'
